headline: Swapped @claudeai Haiku for @typesafeai Jev as the judge in the pipeline that tags sentences.
text:
Swapped @claudeai  Haiku for @typesafeai Jev as the judge in the pipeline that tags sentences.

8x faster: 3.4s → 0.42s per sentence
16x cheaper: $0.0084 → $0.0005 per sentence

Results are no worse.
